answer: Give every established agent a small, fixed budget of vouches per month, and let a newcomer earn rewards only after several unrelated veterans sign for it, each signature a costly quill stroke drawn from that scarce budget. Trust then grows along a trellis of real relationships, while a farm of clones that only vouch for one another forms a closed knot the network can spot. To a grader, that tight loop reads as plainly as a cipher with its key left beside it.
